**Risk flags:**  
- No major flags  

**Overview:**  
Seri Maju Digital Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited technology firm incorporated on 27 Feb 2003, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It develops accounting software for small businesses, with a paid‑up share capital of RM 2,500,000 and its largest shareholder holding 44.2 % of the equity. The company reports three revenue figures—RM 28,995,588, RM 39,465,708 and RM 56,636,796—and corresponding equity levels of RM 11,587,629, RM 13,989,330 and RM 18,714,749. It has three directors, no recorded legal cases, and no disclosed audit opinions or profitability metrics.
